name: observatoire-d4
description: Observatoire personnel D4 — HTML, CSS, JavaScript et SQLite

scripts.pretest: npm run build:ui && npm run build:cloud
scripts.typecheck: node --preserve-symlinks --preserve-symlinks-main node_modules/typescript/lib/tsc.js -p jsconfig.json && node --preserve-symlinks --preserve-symlinks-main node_modules/typescript/lib/tsc.js -p tsconfig.appearance.json && node --preserve-symlinks --preserve-symlinks-main node_modules/typescript/lib/tsc.js -p tsconfig.cloud.json
scripts.build: npm run build:ui && npm run build:cloud && node --preserve-symlinks --preserve-symlinks-main scripts/check.js && npm run typecheck
